title: Valid YAML with an invalid structure crashes run-summary loading
reasoning: The documented contract returns None for invalid run-info files, but only YAML syntax errors are handled. An empty file parses to None, a sequence parses to a list, and summary: null produces a non-mapping summary. Each reaches an unconditional .get call and raises AttributeError, aborting report generation instead of treating the metadata as invalid.
reproduction: Call get_run_summary with an empty run_info.yaml, a YAML sequence at the root, or a mapping containing summary: null.
recommendation: Validate the root and nested summary structures before accessing them, log invalid metadata, and return None according to the documented contract.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: None of the supplied tests exercises get_run_summary or malformed run metadata.
suggestedRegressionTest: Parameterize missing, syntactically invalid, structurally invalid, and valid run metadata, asserting invalid inputs return None and valid mappings retain their summary fields.
